usedFor: Planyo Online Booking holds reservations, and Calendly produces a booking link through “Create Scheduling Link” after “New Reservation”.

bestTemplate.name: “New Reservation” in Planyo Online Booking, then “Create Scheduling Link” in Calendly
bestTemplate.why: A new reservation can lead to a Calendly booking link, which the action creates.

watchOut: “Create Scheduling Link” only creates a link, so getting it to the customer is a separate step you add.
